R608.note: Secure: true closes the finding; HttpOnly and SameSite=Strict are stated hardening with the Strict/Lax trade-off called out, though Strict will drop the session on cross-site top-level navigations if the app relies on inbound links.

R609.note: FromSqlInterpolated parameterizes both tenantId and the %term% pattern; tenant filter, contains semantics, async List<Product> return and empty-term behaviour are all unchanged.

R610.note: Replacing session.Values with a fresh map before writing auth keys is the right shape for a CookieStore (store.New would be a no-op), and the discarding of pre-login values is stated plainly.

R611.note: Template logging plus uXXXX escape-encoding of control chars closes CRLF forging; backslash encoding is stated, though it renders legitimate DOMAIN-backslash-user names with the backslash as u005c in the log despite the write-up's claim that punctuation passes through unchanged.

R612.note: parserBuilder().setSigningKey().parseClaimsJws() verifies the signature and rejects alg=none; the new required Key constructor argument and the swallow-and-continue on JwtException are both stated and necessary for verification.

R613.note: Removing eval() for a closed-grammar arithmetic parser closes the vector, but it rejects PHP-syntax inputs the original accepted (%, **, 1e3, hex literals), adds an unstated 200-char cap, and returns float where the original returned int for integer arithmetic (5 becomes 5.0 in the response).

R614.note: Length check plus subtle.ConstantTimeCompare gives exact equality per the contract; the extra sessionToken empty guard is redundant (both-empty was already rejected by the headerToken guard, contrary to the explanation) but harmless.

R615.note: self.get_object() routes the lookup through the staff/owner-scoped get_queryset() and check_object_permissions(); response body unchanged and other users' invoices still 404 like missing ones.

R616.note: $cgi->escapeHTML() at the print sink entity-encodes both interpolated values; undef params behave as before and no other output changes.

R617.note: Build fails on message.UserId - the real property in the case's ChatMessageStore.cs (which the write-up wrongly says was not provided) is AuthorUserId; the ownership-check design and the stated HubException on not-found/not-owned are otherwise sound.

R618.note: Dropping the is_staff widening makes list() enforce the owner-only rule the docstring declares as the resource's sole policy; the loss of staff-wide listing is stated plainly and matches that policy.
